title: Video Ads for the Famous Artists Course
content: The Famous Artist School marketed its correspondence course with print ads and direct mail, but also with thesevideo adsin the 1950s.The presentation may seem stilted and corny. I'm struck with how comfortable we've all become when talking to a camera.But what they're selling has real value, even to this day, so I'm glad you can still get your hands on those oldcourse instruction binders.Thanks to the Norman Rockwell Museum for digitizing them and sharing them.
